record.dic_text:
01232 Buqqiyahuw {buk-ki:-ya:'-hu:}

源自 01238 和 03050; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Bukkiah 2; 2

布基雅 = "耶和華已淨空"
1) 一位哥轄族的利未人, 希幔的兒子, 被大衛指派在聖幕中擔任樂師的事奉
   (#代上 25:4,13|)
record.edic_text:
01232 Buqqiyah {book-kee-yaw'}

from 01238 and 03050;; n pr m

AV - Bukkiah 2; 2

Bukkiah = "Jehovah has emptied"
1) a Kohathite Levite, of the sons of Heman, one of the musicians in
   the temple
